app.name: Karaoke Party
app.tagline: Everyone sings on their own phone, and the scores show up live.

home.headline: Sing together, from any phone.

upload.title: Upload a song
upload.intro: We'll separate the voice from the music, write down the lyrics and find the melody. It takes a few minutes, and you can leave this page meanwhile.
upload.rights: I confirm I have the right to use this audio (for example, I recorded it or I have a licence for it).
upload.rightsNote: Your song stays private. Only you and the rooms you host can use it.
upload.noConversionsLeft: You've used all {{total}} conversions for this month.

import.title: Import an UltraStar chart
import.intro: Already have an UltraStar chart (.txt) and its audio file? Import them here. This doesn't use up a conversion.

editor.title: Chart editor
editor.readOnly: This is a starter song: you can look, but not change it.
editor.gapHelp: Moves all the lyrics earlier or later. Use it when everything is out of sync with the music.
editor.noNote: Click a note to edit it.
editor.textHelp: Start with a space for a new word. "~" holds the previous syllable.
editor.help: Drag a note to move it, drag its right edge to change its length. Keys: ← → move, ↑ ↓ pitch, Shift + ← → length, Space play/pause, Ctrl+Z undo.

problems.empty_text: Line {{line}}: a note has no text.

mic.title: Your microphone
mic.robot: Test mode: a robot sings instead of your mic.

calibrate.title: Mic delay check
calibrate.intro: Phones add a small delay between your voice and the app. We measure it once so your timing is scored fairly.
calibrate.failed: We couldn't hear you clearly. Get closer to the mic and try again.

ready.needMic: Turn on your microphone to sing.

song.none: The host hasn't picked a song yet.

start.needReady: At least one player must be ready.
start.waiting: Waiting for the host to start…

sing.watching: You're watching this one. Turn on your mic and get ready to sing the next song.

results.title: Results
results.replayNone: No recordings arrived, so there's no replay.
results.waitingHost: Waiting for the host to pick the next song…

lyrics.title: Lyrics (optional)
lyrics.intro: Give the converter the lyrics and it fits them to the voice instead of guessing the words. Much better for screamed, fast or heavily processed singing.
lyrics.noneFound: No lyrics found. Check the title and artist, or paste the lyrics below.
lyrics.otherVersion: Another version (different length): the timing will be shifted to fit your file.
lyrics.placeholder: Paste the lyrics here, one line per line. Or find them online above.
lyrics.hintTimed: The times in [brackets] say when each line starts. Leave them in: they keep every line in sync.
lyrics.hintPlain: No times: the words will be fitted to the voice in one go. Lyrics with times (found online) work best.
lyrics.hintEmpty: Leave empty to let the converter guess the words.
lyrics.redoIntro: Fit new lyrics to the voice of “{{title}}” and rebuild its chart. This takes a few minutes and doesn't use up a conversion.
lyrics.redoWarning: This replaces the song's chart, including any changes you made in the chart editor.
lyrics.redoConfirm: Replace the chart, including your changes in the editor?
lyrics.busy: This song is being worked on. Wait until it's ready.
lyrics.redoFailed: Redoing the lyrics didn't work, so the previous chart was kept

modes.title: Game mode
modes.sing_togetherHelp: Everyone who is ready sings the same song at once.
modes.spotlightHelp: Spotlight: take turns. Add your own song to the queue; while someone sings, everyone else watches, cheers and votes.

spotlight.queueEmpty: Nobody in the queue yet. Add your turn!
spotlight.waitingFor: Waiting for {{names}} to turn on the mic and press ready.
spotlight.partnerHelp: This is a duet: your partner sings part 2.
spotlight.howPoints: Points: 70% pitch score, 30% audience stars (5 stars = 10,000). Several turns are averaged.
spotlight.rate: How was it? Tap the stars.
spotlight.voted: Thanks! You can still change your vote.
spotlight.noAudience: Everyone sang this one, so there's no audience to vote: pitch score only.
